description: T1.12: how long the GI image mean takes to settle within 5% and 1% of a converged field at the calibrated batch (Sponza under budget v2), per hysteresis rule, after the warm-up and after a restart with no warm-up. One scene per run (VITE_DDGI_SCENES, default sponza); rules in VITE_DDGI_HYSTERESIS. Manual, under the bench lock.
